Gear shown on dashboards and HUDs: `R`, `N`, `P`, `D1`..`Dn` in automatic mode and
`M1`..`Mn` while the driver holds a manual gear. Gear 0 is N, or P when `parked`.
Shared so the game HUD, the car cluster and Studio agree.
